name: Rotating Cube (Lighting)
description: Red diffuse cube under a directional light, spinning on Y.

name: Rotating Textured Cube
description: Cube textured with the Pyros logo, spinning on Y.

name: Parallax Mapping
description: Brick cube with diffuse, normal and displacement (parallax) maps.

name: Texture Animation
description: Cube with a 6-frame YoYo texture animation at 30 fps.

name: Rotating Cube (Lighting + Shadows)
description: Directional + point light, both casting shadows, onto a floor/ceiling and a spinning cube.

name: Skybox
description: Cubemap skybox that follows the camera.

name: Decals
description: Left-click places a Pyros logo decal on the cube, sphere or teapot. Free mouse (Tab capture disabled); WASD to move.

name: PBR Spheres
description: Metallic/roughness calibration grid, plus a sphere driven by a metallic-roughness map texture.

name: Many Lights
description: A cloud of cubes lit by many coloured point lights at once.

name: Particles
description: Smoke (alpha-blended, tunable) and embers (additive) particle emitters.

name: Simple Physics
description: 1000 dynamic physics cubes falling onto a static floor, real-time Box3D simulation.

name: Physics Stress (20k)
description: Box3D stress test: small spheres continuously raining into a boxed arena (up to 20k bodies).

name: Skeleton Animation
description: Skinned human model blending between walk/run/alert animations by mouse X position.

name: SSR Test
description: Material-aware screen-space reflections on a glossy floor under an orbiting camera.

name: Ambient Occlusion
description: Ground-truth ambient occlusion (GTAO) darkening the creases between objects.

name: LOD
description: 10k static teapots with 3 LOD levels, frustum culling and point lights.

name: Instanced Shadows
description: 144 blocks in one instanced draw call, casting per-instance directional shadows onto the ground.

name: Volumetric Lights
description: Spot and point lights scattering through the air: shadowed light shafts marched per-pixel in the deferred lighting pass.

name: Grass Field
description: Alpha-cutout grass on crossed quads, chunked into one instanced draw call per grid cell.

name: Island
description: The same island, reflected by screen-space reflections instead: one opaque G-buffer water surface with per-material SSR, no mirror pass and no extra render targets.

name: Ambient Bug Repro
description: Same scene/material as the Forward repro, Deferred renderer, no post effects.

name: Neon Pulse
description: Full Lua breakout-style game - arena, paddle and ball lit through the deferred renderer.

name: Inverse Kinematics
description: Grab any limb and drag it. Four IK handles drive both legs (exact two-bone solve) and both arms (FABRIK) while the walk clip keeps playing - the solve runs inside SkeletonAnimation::update, so the constraint survives the clip rewriting the pose every frame. Left-drag a handle, SPACE pauses the walk.

name: Metro (FPS)
description: A first-person survival shooter in an abandoned metro station: deferred lighting with a flashlight, failing sodium lamps, volumetric shafts and per-shot muzzle flashes. TAB to capture the mouse.

name: Shadow Matrix
description: Three shadow-casting lights at once, one per channel: red directional, green point, blue spot. Every shadow is attributable to its light by colour, so the same scene renders comparably in forward and deferred and across backends.

name: Two Point Shadows
description: Two shadow-casting point lights, green and magenta, one over each box - exercises the per-light cube map indexing.

name: Two Directional Shadows
description: Two shadow-casting directional lights, the red one with 3 cascades and the blue with 1 - exercises the per-cascade matrix indexing.

name: Cornell Box (GI)
description: Ray-traced DDGI. A single WHITE light - every tint on the white floor and the centre block is light that bounced off the red or green wall and carried its colour.

name: Courtyard (baseline)
description: The courtyard every feature demo below is built on: shadow maps and screen-space reflections only.

name: Courtyard (everything)
description: Sun shafts, ray-traced shadows and ray-traced reflections together.

name: Volumetric Clouds
description: The Sky effect's clouds marched through a slab of 3D noise 1.2-2.8 km up, each step lit by the sun through the cloud itself (Beer's law, powder, a forward-scattering phase) - against its flat cloud layer (uCloudVolume 0). Look up: they drift.

name: Destruction
description: Run-time fracture (physics:fracture): a crate, then the stack, the wall and the column break one after another into Voronoi pieces packed round where they are hit - each piece keeps its faces and gets a cap over the cut, and a convex body of its own; a click breaks what is under the cursor.

name: Scene View (Render to Texture)
description: A second camera drawn into a texture a monitor in the scene shows (SceneView): its own renderer, its own size, drawn ahead of the frame's own view and sampled like any other texture - a scope, a security camera, a mirror.

name: Wet Ground and Subsurface
description: Material features: the ground soaked, with puddles fixed in the world (a mirror, its bumps gone); three spheres in a low sun - plain, skin and wax - the last two lit under the surface (subsurface): a wider, warm terminator and light seen through from behind.

name: Rain and Shelter
description: Rain set the way a game sets it (setPostEffectParam("Sky", "uRain")): what faces up out in it soaks and gathers puddles - a mirror of the sky - and what is under the roof stays dry, known from a view straight down round the eye.

name: Sun Shafts
description: Light shafts from a low sun streaming past the courtyard's columns: the sky's light gathered toward the sun on the screen, what stands against the sky casting its shadow through the air.

name: Depth of Field
description: A lens focused at one distance: the heads near the middle sharp, the nearer and the further out of focus - each point blurred by how far it is from the focus, a sharp edge in front not hazed by the blurred background behind it.

name: Motion Blur
description: What moves on screen smeared along its move this frame, as a camera's shutter does - from each surface's own motion vector (the depth prepass), the camera's turn included.

name: Particles (GPU)
description: Two emitters of a million particles each, simulated on the GPU: a compute pass steps every particle each frame - started in its cone, moved on, aged - and the stream it writes is what the particles are drawn from. The CPU only counts how many spawn.

name: Ray-Traced Shadows
description: The courtyard's sun shadows traced through its triangles, a ray a pixel toward a point of the sun's disc - gathered over frames into the penumbra the sun's size makes: sharp where a column meets the ground, softer the further its shadow falls. No shadow map, no cascades.

name: Ray-Traced Reflections
description: Reflections traced through the scene's triangles: the view's ray mirrored at each smooth surface, and what it finds lit by the sun and the sky - what the screen does not show too: the back of a thing, what is behind the camera.
